There were 2 test failures in the run. 

1. tests/test_client.py::test_retry_backoff failed due to an assertion error. The expected delay list was [2.0, 4.0, 8.0], but the actual list was [2.0, 4.0, 6.0]. This discrepancy indicates an issue with the _compute_delays function in Client class.

2. tests/test_session.py::test_token_refresh failed due to an httpx.ConnectTimeout. The test token refresh failed because the client took too long to connect (most probably) to the refresh URL. This might be due to internet issues, the server URL being wrong or the network being slow.

This diff makes the ratelimit.py file robust against time stepping backwards while still handling refills correctly. It adds a check to prevent negative elapsed time from draining the token bucket and ensures tokens don't exceed capacity. It also moved a limitation check to be after the refill calculation.
Merge overlapping windows (spans) by merging adjacent windows separated by a small gap.
The token bucket algorithm regulates the rate at which events are allowed, by allocating tokens at a specified rate and allowing events to pass when tokens are available.
The test that failed because of a database connection error is none. The failure in tests/test_session.py::test_token_refresh was due to an httpx.ConnectTimeout.
It limits the number of times an action can be performed.
